description: This file defines API endpoints for a branding compliance analysis backend, including job creation, status, asset uploads, analysis triggers, and results retrieval, implemented using FastAPI.

classes.name: CreateJobRequest
classes.description: Model representing a request to create a job with optional owner, title, description.

classes.name: CreateJobResponse
classes.description: Model representing the response after creating a job, primarily returning job_id.

classes.name: StatusResponse
classes.description: Model indicating the status of a job including progress metrics.

classes.name: FixAssetRequest
classes.description: Model for requesting a fix of an individual asset with optional strategy.

classes.name: BatchFixRequest
classes.description: Model for requesting batch fixes across assets.

methods.name: create_job(data: CreateJobRequest, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Endpoint to create a new job, initialize workspace, and store job info.

methods.name: delete_job(job_id: str, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Endpoint to delete a job and its workspace.

methods.name: upload_assets_zip(job_id: str, file: UploadFile = File(...), state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Endpoint to upload a zip file of assets and extract into workspace.

methods.name: upload_old_brand(job_id: str, file: UploadFile = File(...), state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Upload an old brand image reference for analysis.

methods.name: upload_new_brand(job_id: str, file: UploadFile = File(...), state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Upload a new brand image reference for fixing overlays.

methods.name: analyze_job(job_id: str, background: BackgroundTasks, request: Request, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Trigger background analysis of a job.

methods.name: get_status(job_id: str, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Retrieve current status and progress of a job.

methods.name: get_results(job_id: str, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: List assets and issues associated with a job.

methods.name: get_asset_preview( job_id: str, asset_id: str, view: Literal["original", "overlay", "fixed"] = Query("original", description="Preview type"), state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store), )
methods.description: Get a preview of a specified asset.

methods.name: fix_single_asset(job_id: str, asset_id: str, req: FixAssetRequest, request: Request, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Apply an automatic fix to a specific asset.

methods.name: batch_fix(job_id: str, req: BatchFixRequest, request: Request, state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store))
methods.description: Run automatic fixes for all assets with issues.

methods.name: download_artifacts( job_id: str, type: Literal["zip", "report", "both"] = Query("zip", description="Artifact type to download"), state: StateStore = Depends(get_state_store), )
methods.description: Download report or assets as zip or report.

search-terms: 资源引用和静态路径构建
